CostumeEnchant

827+ Custom Enchantments • 11 Categories • Configurable Gameplay

CostumeEnchant is a custom enchantment system for Minecraft servers featuring 827+ enchantments organized across 11 categories. It provides configurable enchantments, rarities, effects, cooldowns, particles, sounds, and GUI-based management for servers looking to expand their gameplay options.

✦ Features

- 827+ custom enchantments
- 11 enchantment categories
- Multiple enchantment rarities
- Configurable enchantment levels
- Custom effects and gameplay mechanics
- Cooldown support
- Particles and sound effects
- Enchantment GUI
- Book-based enchantment browser
- Search and information tools
- Apply and remove enchantments
- Configurable messages
- YAML-based configuration
- Player data storage
- PlaceholderAPI integration
- Vault integration
- Built-in API for integrations
- English, German, and Russian language resources

📚 Enchantment Categories

CostumeEnchant includes enchantments across:

- ⚔️ Combat — 114
- 🛡️ Armor — 100
- ⛏️ Mining — 109
- 🛡️ Defense — 59
- 🌾 Farming — 66
- 🎣 Fishing — 60
- ✨ Legendary — 62
- 🔮 Magic — 64
- 🏃 Movement — 63
- ❤️ Survival — 57
- ⚙️ Utility — 73

Total: 827 enchantments

🎮 Commands

Main Command: "/ce"

Aliases:

- "/costumeenchant"
- "/cenchant"

Player Commands

"/ce menu"
Open the enchantment menu.

"/ce search <query>"
Search available enchantments.

"/ce info <enchantment>"
View information about an enchantment.

"/ce list"
List available enchantments.

Admin Commands

"/ce reload"
Reload CostumeEnchant configuration.

"/ce givebook <player> <enchantment> <level>"
Give an enchantment book.

"/ce apply <enchantment>"
Apply an enchantment.

"/ce remove <enchantment>"
Remove an enchantment.

"/book"
Open the administrative enchantment browser.

🔐 Permissions

- "costumeenchant.admin" — Administrative access

- "costumeenchant.remove" — Remove enchantments

"costumeenchant.admin" includes access to the administrative permissions.

🔌 Integrations

CostumeEnchant provides optional integration with:

- PlaceholderAPI — Placeholder support
- Vault — Economy and permission-related integration

These integrations are optional where supported; CostumeEnchant does not require every integration to be installed.

⚙️ Configuration

Configuration covers areas such as:

- Enchantment properties

- Rarities
- Effects
- Cooldowns
- Particles
- Sounds
- Messages
- Language resources
- Gameplay behavior

Included language resources:

🎯 Designed For

- Survival servers
- SMP servers
- Economy servers
- Custom gameplay servers

resources.title: AntiLag+
resources.description: Advanced server performance monitoring, optimization, and anti-lag protection for Paper 26.2+
resources.body:
AntiLag+

A configurable server-performance management plugin for Minecraft servers.

AntiLag+ provides server administrators with practical tools to manage common sources of unnecessary server load. Instead of promising to eliminate lag or guarantee a specific TPS, AntiLag+ focuses on configurable cleanup and server-management features that can be adjusted to fit your server.

✦ Features

⚙️ Configurable Cleanup

Control how and when cleanup tasks are performed.

- Configurable cleanup intervals
- Configurable entity handling
- Remove selected entities when necessary
- Adjustable cleanup behavior
- Configuration-based management

🧹 Entity Management

Keep unnecessary entities under control with configurable rules.

- Item cleanup
- Configurable entity types
- Optional mob/entity cleanup
- Entity whitelist support
- Prevent important entities from being removed

🎛️ Fully Configurable

AntiLag+ is designed to let administrators decide how the plugin behaves.

- Editable configuration
- Adjustable intervals
- Enable/disable individual features
- Customizable messages
- Reload configuration without unnecessary server changes

📊 Lightweight Approach

AntiLag+ performs its management tasks through configurable scheduled operations rather than continuously attempting to modify every aspect of the server.

The plugin does not claim to eliminate all server lag or guarantee a specific TPS/MSPT value. Actual server performance depends on many factors, including hardware, player count, plugins, worlds, entities, redstone activity, view distance, and server configuration.

🛡️ Safe Cleanup

Important entities can be protected through configuration.

Use the whitelist to prevent selected entities from being affected by cleanup operations.

This allows administrators to choose what should and should not be managed by AntiLag+.

🔧 Commands

"/antilag" — Main AntiLag+ command
"/antilag help" — Show available commands
"/antilag reload" — Reload the plugin configuration
"/antilag cleanup" — Run a cleanup operation manually

«Available commands may vary depending on the installed version and configuration.»

🔑 Permissions

"antilag.admin" — Access administrative AntiLag+ commands
"antilag.reload" — Reload the configuration
"antilag.cleanup" — Run manual cleanup

«Permission nodes may vary depending on the installed version.»

📁 Configuration

AntiLag+ stores its settings in a configuration file, allowing server administrators to adjust the plugin without modifying the plugin itself.

Typical settings include:

- Cleanup intervals
- Entity types
- Whitelisted entities
- Cleanup options
- Messages
- Feature toggles

💡 Important

AntiLag+ is a server-management and cleanup tool, not a universal solution for every performance problem.

For the best results, use it together with proper server configuration, reasonable view/simulation distances, optimized plugins, and regular monitoring of server performance.

Performance improvements will vary depending on the server environment and configuration.

Compatibility

Designed for modern Minecraft server environments.

Server software: Paper / compatible Bukkit-based servers
Configuration: YAML
Installation: Place the plugin JAR in your server's "plugins" folder and restart the server.

📌 Disclaimer

AntiLag+ does not guarantee:

- 20 TPS
- A fixed MSPT
- Zero lag
- Elimination of all server performance issues
- Improved performance on every server

Its purpose is to provide administrators with configurable tools for managing cleanup and reducing unnecessary server activity where applicable.

---

AntiLag+

Manage. Configure. Maintain.

A practical approach to keeping unnecessary server activity under control — without unrealistic performance promises.

"clearlagplus.nuke"| Use aggressive nuke cleanup| OP

Placeholders are designed to use cached plugin statistics rather than performing expensive full scans every time they are requested.

⚙️ Default Configuration

By default, ClearLag Plus runs automatic cleanup every 180 seconds and only removes dropped items.

auto-clear:

  interval: 180

cleanup:
  dropped-items: true
  entities: false

🛡️ Safe Cleanup

ClearLag Plus protects important entities by default, including:

The nuke system includes a configurable cooldown and optional countdown.

Players and protected entities are never intentionally targeted by the cleanup system.

📊 Status & Monitoring

- Next cleanup
- Ground item count
- Loaded entity count
- Last cleanup statistics
- TPS

🎨 Modern Message System

Messages use a clean color hierarchy:

- Aqua — ClearLag Plus branding

resources.title: zAntiFreeCam
resources.description: Server-side anti-freecam protection for Paper and Folia, masking underground areas to prevent cave and ore scouting.
resources.body:
zAntiFreeCam

Server-side anti-freecam protection for Paper and Folia.

zAntiFreeCam protects underground areas from being exposed through Freecam-style camera movement and underground scouting. It filters outgoing chunk data sent to surface players instead of modifying the actual world.

Protected underground data can be replaced with a configurable solid mask, preventing caves, ores, air pockets, and other underground information from being exposed to surface players.

No client-side mod is required.

Features

- Server-side underground protection
- No client mod required
- Overworld protection
- Configurable protection Y level
- Solid block masking
- Prevents cave layouts from being exposed through AIR and CAVE_AIR
- Configurable mask block
- Optional underground entity hiding
- Optional block entity stripping
- Automatic remasking when returning to the surface
- World exclusions
- Bypass permission
- Debug and diagnostic options
- Performance controls
- Paper and Folia support

How It Works

By default, blocks below Y=16 are protected for players on the surface.

The default protection settings are:

- Hide below Y: 16
- Reveal below Y: 15
- Mask mode: SOLID
- Mask block: STONE
- Block masking: Enabled
- Block entity stripping: Enabled

Protected positions are represented by the configured mask block instead of the real underground data.

This covers underground data such as:

- Ores
- AIR and CAVE_AIR
- Water and lava
- Chests and other block entities
- Underground terrain

The actual world is never modified. The protection only affects data sent to the player's client.

Players who legitimately move underground can receive the real terrain based on their server-side position.

Example Configuration

The following settings represent the recommended default configuration:

- Protection Y: 16
- Reveal Y: 15
- Mask mode: SOLID
- Mask block: STONE
- Mask blocks: Enabled
- Rewrite: Enabled
- Strip block entities: Enabled
- Reveal radius: 4
- Remask on surface: Enabled

World Protection

Protection is designed for the Overworld.

- Overworld: Protected
- Nether: Not masked
- The End: Not masked

Additional world exclusions can also be configured.

Entity Protection

Underground entities can optionally be hidden from surface players.

- Underground entity hiding: Enabled
- Always visible entities: Configurable
- Hidden entity types: Configurable

Performance

zAntiFreeCam includes configurable limits for chunk updates and state checks.

- Maximum updates per tick: 32
- Chunk refresh delay: 150 ms
- Dirty chunk limit: 256
- State check interval: 10 ticks

Permission

zantifreecam.bypass

Allows a player to bypass underground visibility protection.

Commands

- "/zantifreecam"
- "/zantifreecam reload"
- "/zantifreecam bypass"
- "/zantifreecam bypass <player>"
- "/zantifreecam status"

Compatibility

- Paper
- Folia
- Minecraft 26.x
- Java 25

zAntiFreeCam by KingBrezz

Sub-Areas

Create specialized areas inside your land.

Each sub-area can have its own:

- Boundaries
- Members
- Roles
- Flags
- Permissions
- Rent settings

Perfect for shops, farms, public areas, private rooms and other specialized zones.

---

Land Levels

Turn territory development into progression.

- Land XP
- Configurable requirements
- Level rewards
- Configurable benefits
- Maximum members
- Maximum claims
- Maximum sub-areas
- API-based requirements

Build a progression system that grows together with your server.

---

Economy

Create a player-driven territory economy.

ClaimCore supports:

- Land balance
- Deposits
- Withdrawals
- Taxes
- Upkeep
- Rent
- Sales
- Rewards
- Configurable costs

Vault integration can be used when available, while optional internal economy functionality can be configured where appropriate.

---

Rent & Sales

Turn territory into an actual marketplace.

Players can configure:

- Rentable areas
- Rental prices
- Rental duration
- Automatic expiration
- Purchase prices
- Seller settings
- Renter permissions
- Renewal
- Cancellation

Build shops, apartments, farms, commercial areas and player-owned territories.

---

Nations

Bring multiple lands together under one organization.

Nations support:

- Nation creation
- Capitals
- Member lands
- Nation taxes
- Nation upkeep
- Allies
- Enemies
- Nation management
- Configurable nation limits
- Capital protection
- Distance rules

Create larger communities without losing individual land ownership.

---

Wars

Turn territory management into server-wide competition.

Configure:

- War declarations
- Preparation time
- Requirements
- Acceptance rules
- Active wars
- Territory capture
- Capture duration
- Capture interruption
- Rewards
- War shields
- Post-war protection

Wars can be configured to fit your server's gameplay style.

---

Land Titles

Give players visual feedback when entering territory.

Example:

Land Name: "%land_name%"

Owner: "%owner_name%"

The title system is fully configurable and can be enabled or disabled according to your server's design.

---

Land Chat

Keep territory communication organized.

- Land chat
- Member chat
- Custom chat formats
- Permission-controlled communication

Useful for private communities, towns, nations and player organizations.

---

Inbox

Keep important territory activity in one place.

Players can receive:

- Land invitations
- Nation invitations
- Requests
- Notifications
- Management updates

---

Rankings

Showcase the most active and developed territories.

Track information such as:

- Top Lands
- Top Leaders
- Land Level
- Land Balance
- Members
- Activity
- Claimed Area

Create competitive progression without requiring another ranking system.

---

Modern Management GUI

Manage your territory from a centralized interface.

The management system provides access to:

- Land information
- Members
- Roles
- Flags
- Sub-areas
- Economy
- Rent & Sales
- Statistics
- Settings
- Nations
- Wars

Designed to keep complex management simple for players.

---

Discord Integration

Connect your Minecraft communities with Discord.

"ClaimCore Discord"
![Discord](https://i.imgur.com/HHRQUOK.jpeg)

Optional Discord integration can provide:

- Discord Bot
- Webhooks
- Server status
- Leaderboards
- Notifications
- Land events
- Nation events
- Community synchronization

Discord functionality requires the appropriate external Discord configuration.

---

Multi-Server Ready

Designed with network environments in mind.

ClaimCore supports optional:

- MySQL storage
- Redis synchronization
- Land synchronization
- Nation synchronization
- War synchronization
- Versioned events
- Cache invalidation
- Multi-server data updates

Redis and MySQL are optional and are not required for a basic single-server installation.

---

Bedrock Friendly

Designed for Java + Bedrock communities.

When compatible Bedrock form integrations are available, ClaimCore can provide management interfaces for:

- Lands
- Members
- Roles
- Flags
- Nations
- Wars
- Other management systems

Java players continue using the standard Minecraft inventory GUI.

---

Developer API

Build your own integrations around ClaimCore.

The API is designed to provide access to core systems including:

- Lands
- Players
- Members
- Roles
- Flags
- Sub-areas
- Nations
- Wars
- Economy
- Levels
- Requirements
- Rewards

Example:

ClaimCoreAPI api = ClaimCore.getAPI();

Land land = api.getLand(player.getUniqueId());

Custom plugins can use the API to integrate ClaimCore into their own systems.

---

PlaceholderAPI

When PlaceholderAPI is installed, ClaimCore can expose information such as:

%land_name%
%land_id%
%owner_name%
%owner_uuid%
%land_world%
%land_level%
%land_xp%
%land_balance%
%land_members%
%land_chunks%
%player_role%
%player_land%
%nation_name%
%nation_id%

Use land and nation information across compatible scoreboards, chat systems, menus and other integrations.

---

Performance Focused

ClaimCore is designed with performance in mind.

- Chunk-based spatial lookup
- Efficient territory detection
- Cached lookups
- Async database operations
- Modular integrations
- Redis synchronization
- No unnecessary global land scanning

The architecture is designed to support large numbers of claims without relying on expensive full-land iteration for every protection check.

---

Configuration

Your server. Your rules.

ClaimCore provides configurable systems for:

- Claims
- Protection
- Flags
- Roles
- Members
- GUIs
- Messages
- Land levels
- Requirements
- Rewards
- Economy
- Taxes
- Upkeep
- Rent
- Sales
- Nations
- Wars
- Shields
- Integrations

Player-facing messages and important gameplay settings can be customized to match your server.

---

Optional Integrations

ClaimCore can integrate with supported server tools when installed.

- PlaceholderAPI
- Vault
- WorldGuard
- WorldEdit
- MySQL
- Redis
- Discord
- Dynmap
- BlueMap
- Pl3xMap
- Squaremap
- Floodgate / Bedrock integrations

Optional integrations are isolated so missing integrations do not prevent the core plugin from operating.

---

Compatibility

Platform: Paper

Minecraft: 26.2+

Java: 25+

Database: SQLite / MySQL depending on configuration

Synchronization: Redis when enabled

Bedrock: Supported integrations

Paper is the primary supported platform. Paper-based forks may work but should be tested against your exact server version before production deployment.

---

Commands

Player

/claim
/land
/lands
/claimcore

Administration

/claimcore reload
/claimcore status
/claimcore leaderboard
/claimcore sync

Additional commands may be available depending on the enabled ClaimCore modules and version.

---

Permissions

claimcore.admin
claimcore.reload
claimcore.status
claimcore.sync
claimcore.leaderboard

claimcore.land
claimcore.land.create
claimcore.land.manage

claimcore.member
claimcore.member.trust
claimcore.member.untrust

claimcore.role
claimcore.role.manage

claimcore.flag
claimcore.flag.manage

claimcore.subarea
claimcore.subarea.manage

claimcore.nation
claimcore.nation.manage

claimcore.war
claimcore.war.manage

---

Made For

SURVIVAL • SMP • ECONOMY • DONUTSMP • TOWNY-STYLE • NETWORKS

Whether you are running a small SMP or a large community server, ClaimCore provides the foundation for player-owned territory and server-wide land management.

---

Production Note

ClaimCore is designed for production server environments, but every server has a different configuration.

Before deploying to a production network, test ClaimCore with your exact:

- Minecraft version
- Java version
- Server software
- Database
- Optional integrations
- Network configuration

External integrations such as MySQL, Redis, Discord and Bedrock forms may require additional configuration.

---

ClaimCore

Protect your land. Build your territory. Control your world.

resources.title: BedrockAntiDupe
resources.description: Dupes ruining your economy? Not anymore. BedrockAntiDupe detects and blocks item duplication exploits with lightweight, server-friendly protection.
resources.body:
🛡️ BedrockAntiDupe

Protect your economy. Stop dupes before they spread.

BedrockAntiDupe is a lightweight anti-duplication plugin built for Minecraft servers that want reliable protection without unnecessary performance overhead.

Duplication exploits can quickly turn a healthy server economy into a mess. BedrockAntiDupe adds an extra layer of protection by monitoring for suspicious duplication behavior and helping prevent duplicated items from affecting your server.

✨ Why BedrockAntiDupe?

⚡ Lightweight by design
Protection shouldn't come at the cost of your server's performance. BedrockAntiDupe is designed to keep its footprint small while doing its job.

🛡️ Built around prevention
BedrockAntiDupe focuses on detecting suspicious behavior and preventing duplication from spreading across your server.

🔧 Simple to use
Drop the plugin into your server, configure it to fit your setup, and let it work in the background.

📦 No unnecessary dependencies
BedrockAntiDupe works without requiring additional plugins.

🎮 Compatibility

BedrockAntiDupe 2.0.0 currently supports:

- Paper
- Purpur
- Spigot
- Minecraft 26.2

🧩 Made for Real Servers

Whether you're running a private survival server, SMP, or a larger community, your economy matters.

One duplication exploit can turn hours of progression into worthless items and disrupt the balance of your entire server. BedrockAntiDupe is made to give server owners another line of defense.

🔒 Keep your economy yours.

Detect it. Stop it. Keep playing.
